data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 11.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2018: GBP 8.3m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2018: predominantly from the nuclear property class).

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 39.661m and disclosed a release of technical reserves in respect of prior years of GBP 11.2m in 2019, predominantly arising from the nuclear/property exposures. This movement is reported as a release (favourable claims development) and represents approximately a 28.3% reduction relative to opening gross claims outstanding. The managing commentary references historic nuclear events (e.g. Fukushima) in discussing exposures but attributes the prior-year reserve release mainly to improved development in the nuclear property class.
raw_causal_phrases: released GBP 11.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2018: GBP 8.3m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure is taken from narrative note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a release of GBP 11.2m. The note text does not include an explicit labelled 'Insurance liabilities' (gross) column number for prior-year movement; the reported figure is assumed to be a gross movement in 'technical reserves'. Claims development triangle is present and could be used to cross-check but the narrative figure was used as the primary source. Some named events are cited in narrative/underwriter commentary rather than quantified in the reserves note.
